missing_evidence: Hash reputation/sandbox verdicts for PDFEditorSetup.exe (e18c80a7…) and svchost-update.exe (0387e063…) and whether either is known-bad in threat intel
Full process tree and any additional child processes or dropped files beyond b7.zip, plus memory image of SALES-LT-07 before remediation
Confirmation of what exactly was in the 2.4 MB upload (b7.zip contents) and whether it included CRM/mail session cookies or customer records
Ownership/registration of 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.10, cdn-sync-update.example and pdf-editor-free.example, and any proxy/DNS logs showing other internal hosts resolving them

Attribution of the 2026-10-05 07:58 SSO sign-in from 192.0.2.61 (state links it to account aina / MKT-LT-11) — confirm whether it is unrelated or a post-compromise access, and review farah's CRM/mail audit logs from 2026-10-04 21:42 onward for use of the stolen session
Whether the download was user-initiated via search/advertisement or delivered through an email/message (no phishing artefact in this batch)
Any change-management record that could explain the download/installation on SALES-LT-07

analysis.scope: SALES-LT-07 and account farah (SSO, mail and CRM sessions); C2 at 203.0.113.45 / cdn-sync-update.example

findings.summary: SALES-LT-07 ran an unsigned installer (PDFEditorSetup.exe) downloaded from pdf-editor-free.example, which started an unsigned svchost-update.exe from AppData\Roaming\SyncUpdate.
svchost-update.exe read the Chrome password and cookie stores (EDR rule CRED-BROWSER-READ): farah's saved credentials and session cookies must be treated as stolen.
A 2.4 MB archive (b7.zip) was staged and uploaded to 203.0.113.45, resolved from cdn-sync-update.example.
Persistence was set through the HKCU Run key 'SyncUpdate' and the host kept beaconing to 203.0.113.45 until 08:12 on 5 Oct: the infection is still active.
farah holds an SSO session and a CRM session (crm-s-7731) opened from SALES-LT-07 before the theft; the CRM stores customer data.
Activity on MKT-LT-11 (aina) and HR-LT-02 (daniel) is signed, routine software and is not linked to this incident.

analysis.scope: Account farah and CRM customer data; SALES-LT-07 contained; attacker at 198.51.100.23

findings.summary: farah's stolen CRM session crm-s-7731 was replayed from 198.51.100.23 on a new device fingerprint at 10:20, after the IdP session had been revoked.
The replayed session exported 1,200 customer records (name, phone, email, company) and downloaded export_customers_central.csv.
The earlier session revocation failed in the CRM during vendor maintenance; the CRM admin API is available again.
Farah was in a client meeting from 10:00 and has not used the CRM today: the 10:20 CRM activity is the attacker.
SALES-LT-07 is contained: its outbound connection to 203.0.113.45 was dropped.

The replayed session exported 1,200 customer records (name, phone, email, company) and downloaded export_customers_central.csv.

proposal.rationale: The stolen CRM session crm-s-7731 was replayed from 198.51.100.23 and used to export 1,200 customer records. The first revocation failed in the CRM during vendor maintenance; the admin API is back, so revoking again closes the attacker's live session. POL-07 permits a SOC analyst to approve revoking sessions alone.
proposal.risk: Farah is signed out of every service again.
proposal.expected_effect: Active sessions for farah revoked in idp, mail and crm, including crm-s-7731.

proposal.rationale: The attacker holds farah's stolen browser credentials and is actively trying to sign in from 198.51.100.23. Disabling the account blocks new sign-ins until a user-assisted reset is done. POL-02 requires IT-manager approval to disable a staff account.
proposal.risk: Farah cannot work until the account is re-enabled.
proposal.expected_effect: New sign-ins for farah are blocked at the identity provider.
validation_checks: Sign-in attempts for farah are rejected as disabled

results.observed_effect: SALES-LT-07 network-contained by the EDR; only the EDR management channel remains.
side_effects: farah cannot use SALES-LT-07 until isolation is lifted.

results.observed_effect: Sessions for farah revoked in: idp, mail. FAILED in crm (CRM admin API unavailable: scheduled vendor maintenance until 10:30). Sessions in crm remain valid.
Active sessions for farah revoked in: idp, mail, crm.
